intro: A Crocolisk Tear is a curious alchemical reagent gathered from the crocolisks inhabiting the waters of Loch Modan. It is sought by Chief Engineer Hinderweir to synthesize a neutralizing mixture capable of disarming Dark Iron explosives.

p: Loch crocolisks are hardy reptiles native to the temperate waters of Loch Modan. While hunters often prize their skins and meat, Chief Engineer Hinderweir discovered an unexpected utility in their secretions. Combined with potent spider venom and resonant ogre minerals, the tear of a crocolisk provides the specific chemical properties needed to counteract volatile Dark Iron demolition charges threatening the Stonewrought Dam.
